rules: Exact legacy strings and metrics are preserved without recomputation.
Every source-row hash includes the original CRLF record terminator.
A missing run manifest remains missing.
Plausible title or timestamp matches are not deterministic artifact links.
Legacy acceptance maps only to the row-level neutral lifecycle.
Every legacy row is production ineligible.
Current Kite or other current-market evidence is prohibited.
Unknown exact-run components use UNRESOLVED_NO_RUN_MANIFEST rather than current configuration.
